card.config_read: ettelem config through the kit's guard at the start and the end, holding card 1's lock under timeout 10: expected TDP 65 W, threshold 65 C, 600 MHz (as E137, 2 Nov 2026, and E184 arm B, 8 Nov 2026, read it); a different start reading stops the session before its first launch (a gate: no data); the end reading is reported
card.lock: /run/lock/etsoc-shire1.lock, held for the session (flock -n), never card 0's
card.processes: one host process at a time on the card, under timeout 10
card.select: ET_DEVICES=1 for every process that opens a device (V3_DEVICE=1 in claims-v3 runners)
card.which: aifoundry1 card 1 (the ledger's card 'aifoundry1-c1'), 600 MHz as found; nothing set, reads only

c_arithmetic.how: a pass = 8 s idle + the host process (set-up, K launches, its checks) + 10 s idle + the sampler's start and stop (3 s) + bookkeeping (5 s); the rest of the 50 minutes is the die gate's waits (heat carries over) and the sampler's retries

card_minutes.rule: about 95 card-minutes, cap 110: no pass starts after 108 card-minutes from the first card command; the session ends by 110

copy-random.host: workloads/ledger build (kernel .text 5e00e45a...), --card, through E191's runner (to be made from E189's kit, with card 1's selection)
copy-random.rule: main.cpp: a launch starts only while 9.5 s - elapsed >= the guard's model + 0.5 s; K = the most that start at the band's slow end, capped at energy.sh's 6 s target at the point

sparse-parity.rule: energy.sh's fit rule at the band's slow end: the host starts a launch only while floor(min(timeout, budget - elapsed - 0.5)) >= max(1, 1.25 guard + 0.5)

die_gate.rule: a pass starts only when minshire[0] reads 60 C or less (waits up to 10 minutes, then the pass is skipped, no data); a die below 52 C does not block (the pass is scored given its own T0 and labelled 'T0 below the forecast band')

order.rule: four independent passes a configuration, one host process each; each round holds every configuration once, shuffled by random.Random(191); written out here, never re-drawn
sequence: the counters arm (6 launches; only if its desk test passed; REPORTED)
the closing reads (ettelem config: TDP and threshold), release

stops.clock: every sample must read 600 MHz: the first sample off it sets its pass aside; a second one (any pass) stops the session
stops.rule: a live sample at or above 65 W board or 70 C on minshire[0] ends the queue: the running process finishes (never killed), no further pass starts, the closing reads, release

window.after_E189: E191's kit is made from E189's after E189's real day; E191 runs on another box (aifoundry1), so E189's and E183's sessions on aifoundry3 do not gate it beyond its go
window.alone: from his go at G (box access as the kit says on the day): last start G+1:30, last end G+3:30, inside one Pacific day; the day's post as the lab's rule stands that day (the owner waived it for Fri 13 Nov 2026, his words about 11:30 PST)
window.one_session: never two sessions of ours on aifoundry1 at once, on either card (the runners count device openers and the driver's use count across both cards): any other session of ours there, on card 0 or card 1, goes before or after E191, never beside it
